name: ScrollPrompt
author: simpliplugin

sections.description:
ScrollPrompt is a lightweight WordPress plugin that helps website owners engage visitors with customizable scroll-triggered call-to-action boxes.

Instead of displaying a popup immediately when someone opens your website, ScrollPrompt allows you to show a targeted message after visitors scroll to a specific point on the page.

Whether you want to encourage newsletter signups, promote special offers, highlight important announcements, or invite visitors to contact your business, ScrollPrompt helps you display your message at the right moment.

Key Features

  • Scroll-Depth Triggers: Display a call-to-action box when visitors reach a specified scroll position.
  • Custom Messages: Create personalized messages to promote offers, announcements, services, or important content.
  • Email Signup Prompts: Encourage visitors to subscribe to your newsletter or mailing list.
  • Flexible Slide-in Position: Choose whether the prompt appears from the left or right side of the screen.
  • Cookie-Based Display Control: Manage repeated prompt appearances using cookie-based controls.
  • Device Targeting: Control prompt visibility based on the visitor’s device.
  • Mobile-Friendly Design: Display prompts with responsive styling across desktop and mobile devices.
  • Simple Admin Settings: Configure prompt content and display behavior directly from your WordPress dashboard.

How ScrollPrompt Works

  1. Install and activate ScrollPrompt on your WordPress website.
  2. Open the ScrollPrompt settings page in your WordPress dashboard.
  3. Configure your message and scroll-trigger settings.
  4. Select the slide-in position and available device targeting options.
  5. Save your settings.

When visitors reach the configured scroll position, ScrollPrompt displays the call-to-action box according to your selected settings.

Common Use Cases

  • Newsletter Promotion: Invite visitors to sign up for updates and announcements.
  • Special Offers: Highlight promotional messages after visitors engage with your content.
  • Business Inquiries: Encourage potential customers to get in touch.
  • Important Announcements: Display relevant information without showing an immediate popup on page load.
  • Visitor Engagement: Present targeted messages while visitors browse your website.

Lightweight and Easy to Configure

ScrollPrompt provides a straightforward way to create scroll-triggered prompts without requiring advanced technical knowledge.

Its settings allow website owners to control when and how the prompt appears, while the responsive design helps keep the experience suitable for different screen sizes.

Current Version

ScrollPrompt 1.0.0 supports one scroll-triggered box per website.

Multiple boxes, split-testing, and advanced combined time-and-scroll triggers are not included in this release.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the scroll-prompt folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Configure the plugin via the ScrollPrompt menu in the admin dashboard.
sections.faq:
Can I show multiple boxes?

The free version supports only one scroll box. The Pro version will support multiple.

How do I change the slide-in position?

Go to ScrollPrompt Settings in the WordPress admin and choose left or right.
